exposure: fetal exposure time - intrauterine or perinatal
pesticides in maternal and umbilical cord blood
Maternal exposure to environmental pollutants (metals, perfluoroalkyl chemicals, pesticides)
Delivery mode (cesarean section vs vaginal delivery)
outcome: Changes in early-life gut microbiome development
cohort: Infants from a Brazilian birth cohort
finding: Perinatal exposure to environmental pollutants is associated with alterations in gut microbiome development, with a stronger effect observed in infants born by cesarean section and those who were breastfed.
mod_finding: The effect of environmental pollutant exposure on the infant gut microbiome was greater in infants born by cesarean section compared to those born vaginally.
